name: fde-app
description: FDE App works like a Forward Deployed Engineer inside your company: it documents how your company really runs, then ranks what slows it down and plans what to change.
suggestedPrompts: Our SOPs are out of date. Help me document how we actually run.
Map our workflows from these meeting transcripts and show who does what.
Where is our team losing time, and what should we automate first?
